summary: 现有 trusted coordinator/profile/session 机制可承载新固定 provider binding，不依赖 SQL23；纯配置仍缺 provider policy、实际 broker headers、完整 reasoning history 证明。须等待 Go19/JS2 整合后登记精确源码，再新建并实际验证资格。动态 host.configure 是独立 L04 工作，仍未完成。

resource_access_only.actual_success: GET200 and nonstream POST200; thinking disabled, max_tokens256, no tools. Does not establish SSE/high-thinking/tool/runtime capability.
resource_access_only.old_first_probe: HTTP200 but reasoning-only finish length and actual exit1 preserved; cannot relabel successful coding completion.

observed_findings.fact: CredentialRef must equal CredentialRevision, vault record not revoked and Provider equals ModelConfig.provider. Keep provider opencode-go. api openai-completions is a separate driver identity.

Go posts exact provider.Endpoint; worker uses config.endpoint as SDK baseUrl but discards actual SDK URL/headers in broker fetch. Existing tests use full endpoint /v1/chat/completions. New actual endpoint must be https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/chat/completions, with SDK baseUrl https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1, derived under exact policy. Setting Go endpoint to base URL alone is incorrect.

Fixed SDK supports openai-completions with arbitrary provider identity; model.headers and options.headers are legal but worker discards SDK transport headers. SDK generic affinity never produces x-opencode-session. opencode.ai detection is nonstandard but not DeepSeek, so explicit deepseek compat required. No SDK fork change necessary.

Current model.reasoning false, session thinkingLevel off; body whitelists exclude thinking. Merely adding fields to config currently has no effect. SDK off here does not explicitly disable provider server default; access evidence demonstrates default can spend all small token budget reasoning.

Fixed SDK supports reasoning_content and opencode-go reasoning->reasoning_content signature normalization, explicit deepseek thinking enabled/disabled, and assistant reasoning replay. Current host request-history semantic comparator discards reasoning when comparing both SDK and wire histories; it cannot prove preserved tool-round reasoning. This is a precise stronger-verification requirement, not evidence of an observed live failure.

Qualification bootstrap allows only exact MODEL route and at most2 calls; TOOL during bootstrap must still be refused. After a real independent accepted runtime qualification, new ordinary task can exercise explicit permitted TOOL route. A model-only bootstrap receipt cannot claim actual tool use.

Both construct Host.Dir as dataRoot/host. Successful credential resides under isolated authorized resource root. A coordinator using another dataRoot will not resolve that ref. Bind the existing protected Host/dataRoot through supported control config or require a separately reviewed host composition change; do not move/copy vault or assume ref is global. Starting new control must respect one coordinator/lease per same product DB. No private DB inventory was inspected.

sdk_policy_proposal.policy_binding: Exact versioned policy is hashed within immutable profile model_config and original effect authority; no arbitrary headers map, fallback endpoint/provider/model selection, or mutable global SDK defaults.
sdk_policy_proposal.wire_body: Require actual SDK output thinking exactly {type:enabled}, reasoning_effort exactly high, max_tokens equal frozen positive cap<=8192, no conflicting max_completion_tokens. Permit thinking only for this exact versioned policy; default old profiles unchanged. No unsupported thinking budget field. Keep complete tools byte/hash binding. Strict:true tool schemas require separate demonstrated provider support; first policy uses non-strict normal function schemas and existing host tool schema checks.
sdk_policy_proposal.bounds: Candidate numerical qualification policy should freeze max_output_tokens8192 and <=2 MODEL calls for bootstrap, positive pre-reserved monetary upper bound. Ordinary first tool demonstration can freeze max_calls4, one bounded local read tool; final chosen caps and price basis require owner resource budget registration. 8192 is current product ceiling, not a provider recommendation or guarantee high reasoning finishes. Existing 90s/2MiB SSE/48KiB request bounds remain; length/time/budget exhaustion is real non-success, never implicit disabled-thinking fallback or truncation. Any larger bound requires separate scope.
sdk_policy_proposal.headers: Trusted Go broker generates User-Agent ResearchOS/2.4 and stable x-opencode-session, never forwards worker arbitrary headers. Derive a versioned opaque hash from trusted project+canonical session_id when exact task/run/session binding exists; qualification with no session uses separate project+qualification task namespace. Include project to avoid cross-project reuse; no credential/private paths/epoch/per-call random value. Missing/ambiguous expected session binding fails before HTTP. Same session remains stable over MODEL/tool/STEER rounds.
sdk_policy_proposal.header_evidence: Before PREPARED, derive nonsecret transport binding from frozen profile and canonical dispatch/session facts, bind it to canonical original effect request/hash; actual HTTP must equal these values. Independently recompute in verification. Do not treat worker-claimed headers or terminal receipt alone as authority. Legacy request hashing stays unchanged without new policy.
sdk_policy_proposal.thinking_history: Verify previous confirmed raw SSE thinking against SDK thinking blocks/signatures, then next provider assistant reasoning_content including every preceding tool round. Preserve exact SDK serialization rules (field alias normalization/newline joining/empty field under compat), not whitespace normalization or dropping fields. Mutated/omitted/reordered reasoning fails even when visible content and tools are identical. Keep canonical consumed STEER/FOLLOW_UP ordering and original full request checks after Go19 merge.
sdk_policy_proposal.quarantine: Go19 decoded/cross-chunk secret quarantine remains before any SDK/public observation. Include thinking fields, tool argument strings, raw/error responses and multiline escaped split secrets in meaningful tests. Rejected/partial/UNKNOWN keeps original effect identity and unspent/unknown cost semantics; no request retry and no credential substitution.

minimal_source_scope_candidate_after_str.bounds: Parse exact optional provider_policy; derive fixed SDK Model/compat/baseUrl/high thinking; validate thinking body. Preserve new stream wrapper, command queue, secrets isolation, bounds and direct-network denial.

Exact optional policy config and request validation; thinking/max_tokens constraints and transport derivation validation helper if common. Preserve all legacy fields/bounds, bootstrap MODEL-only and max2.
Derive canonical policy transport binding before effect PREPARED from existing dispatch/session authority, bind original request hash; no mutable worker header authority, no new route fallback.
Use only bound complete endpoint/UA/session header, compare derived transport facts; retain credential callback, no redirects/proxy/retry, existing stream/UNKNOWN handling and secret quarantine.
New policy exact transport and reasoning history proof layered onto all Go19 canonical stream/consumption guards; no legacy acceptance bypass.
Config/body/semantic full-history positive and tamper negatives, old fixture behavior unchanged.

Real SDK+broker local fixtures, canonical session header continuity/different project isolation, endpoint/credential-provider mismatch before request, real tools and secret quarantine; no paid service.
Actual fixed SDK reasoning/tool multi-round, bounded/cancel/EOF and high-think payload proof; use genuine stream producer, not hand-built synthetic SDK completion.
